catalysts.headline: Scheduled FDA End-of-Phase 1 Type B meeting for NEO212 (in-person, FDA White Oak campus) to discuss Phase 2 study design, proposed patient population, trial design/endpoints, dose selection, and potential for an accelerated-approval pathway. FDA End-of-Phase 1 Type B meeting for NEO212 confirmed scheduled, in-person at the FDA's White Oak campus, to get feedback on patient population, trial design, endpoints, dose, and the accelerated-approval pathway
catalysts.note: No outcome yet (meeting is in the future as of this pass). An earlier End-of-Phase 1 meeting set for 2026-07-09 was canceled after FDA CMC feedback requiring an in vivo relative bioavailability study for the capsule-to-tablet transition. Company caveats: efficacy/safety not established, FDA feedback may differ from expectations, meeting could be rescheduled.

notes: Phase 1 NEO212 data found in background sources: dose escalation was discontinued after a dose-limiting toxicity at 810 mg; 610 mg was selected as the recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D). The company reported one partial response in a recurrent glioblastoma patient and one case of ~16-month stable disease in a lung-cancer brain-metastasis patient; the company itself cautions these individual results do not establish efficacy and require confirmation in larger studies. The Nov 17, 2026 FDA meeting outcome is not yet known (meeting is still ~6 days out as of 2026-11-11); the company has also cautioned the meeting's format/date could change and that FDA feedback may differ from NeOnc's proposals.
